findings.desc: quality: packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:598-617 (capText/boundPersistedFindings) silently caps each persisted finding field (title<=200, file<=300, description<=1000, fix<=1000 chars) with no truncation marker. Array-level truncation IS auditable (findingCount stays the TRUE count while findings.length can be <=50, so a reader can detect the array was capped), but per-field truncation is silent: capText() just slices, so a reader of the persisted verdict JSON or --json output cannot tell whether a title/description/fix was cut short vs organically that length. This undermines the CHK-004 goal of the artifact being a trustworthy, complete-or-visibly-incomplete audit record.

CHK-002:edge:0 evidence is vacuous: it is pinned to the SAME selector as CHK-002:happy:0 (packages/main/src/tasks/full-suite-runner-smoke.ts:171, printed by the composed-chain assertion at lines 168-170), not to the actual distinguishing assertion at lines 160-163 (mainOnlyMessage stalePolicy check for prefix members). I confirmed by mutation test: neutralizing the line 160-163 assertWithDetail condition to a constant true still prints the pinned selector line and exits 0 (verified by patching packages/main/dist/tasks/full-suite-runner-smoke.js locally, running it, then restoring the original file byte-for-byte). So a regression or deletion of the mainOnlyMessage check would leave the edge:0 receipt result=pass/selectorMatched=true unchanged; the pinned evidence provides no mechanical proof that the edge intent (prefix members are not reported as stalePolicy against the main chain alone) is actually being exercised. Fix: pin CHK-002:edge:0 to a distinct process.stdout.write emitted right after the mainOnlyMessage assertWithDetail succeeds (mirroring the pattern already used for the other three CHK-002 selectors), then re-add the evidence against the new distinct selector.

quality: .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-dc2e/plan.md:3 states "Every smoke's default output stays under 11000 characters" but packages/main/src/tasks/validation-tier-planner-smoke.ts default stdout is measured at 10822 chars (node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-tier-planner-smoke.js), a 178-char / 1.6% margin, and no assertion in the file enforces this bound (contrast single-owner-extraction-smoke.ts, which has an explicit self-bound assertion for its own output length). A small future addition to this 3760+-line smoke silently breaks the documented plan.md convention with nothing catching it; the executor's hard trimOutput cap (MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=12000, core/validation-executor.ts:40) still has 1178 chars of headroom, so this is a maintainability/fragility gap, not an active truncation bug.
